turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Yes, can you help me with my hotel plans?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Yes, I can certainly help you with that. Is there an area of town you prefer to stay in? And do you have a price range in mind?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I want to stay in Cambridge and I need a cheap hotel.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: I have about 10 options of cheaper rooms. Most are guesthouses and 1 is a hotel. Do you prefer one over the other?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I prefer a hotel. Preferably one with free parking.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Is there a particular side of town you prefer?

turns.speaker: Learner

turns.text: The hotel is located in the west. Would you like a guesthouse instead?

turns.speaker: Learner
